### CleanPool

:material-waves: streaming (requires `more`) · :material-new-box: since v258

Clean unused images depending on the specified mode. Note that it does not process vendon and host images.

```go
func (c *Client) CleanPool(ctx context.Context, in CleanPoolIn) iter.Seq2[*CleanPoolOut, error]
```

**Parameters**

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `allowInteractiveAuthentication` | `?bool` | Controls whether interactive authentication (via polkit) shall be allowed. If unspecified defaults to false. |
| `mode` | `CleanPoolMode` | Allows removing all or only hidden images |

**Reply**

| Field | Type | Description |

## Types

### AcquireMetadata

A enum field allowing to gracefully get metadata

| Value | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `no` | Do not include metadata in the output |
| `yes` | Include metadata in the output |
| `graceful` | Include metadata in the output, but gracefully eat up errors |

### CleanPoolMode

A enum field allowing to control what type of images are cleaned up

| Value | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `all` | Remove all unused images |
| `hidden` | Remove only hidden images |

## Errors

| Error | Go type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `NoSuchImage` | `NoSuchImageError` | No matching image exists |
| `TooManyOperations` | `TooManyOperationsError` | Too many ongoing background operations |
| `NotSupported` | `NotSupportedError` | Requested operation is not supported |
